QuestInfo.name: Awakened Spirit
QuestInfo.0: Haku won't stop talking to you. It was easy to ignore him at first, but now he's getting annoying. Just get it over with and listen to him for a few seconds.
QuestInfo.1: Now that you're on Maple World, Haku can maintain his original form and carry you! He just needs a way to store spiritual power. Kobayakawa Takakage in Momijigaoka might have something for him.
QuestInfo.2: After eating the mushroom filled with spiritual power, Haku feels strong enough to carry you. Now you can ride on him whenever you feel like going somewhere!
